translation: Flavor sweet, slightly warm, cold and draining, slightly toxic. It disperses phlegm-bound [matter] above the chest with spittle like glue and lacquer (胸上痰結唾如膠漆), phlegm-water of the heart and ribs (心脅痰水), retained drink of the bladder (膀胱留飲), wind-qi and damp dead flesh between the skin (風氣濕皮間死肉), eye discharge and  (chī) in the eyes (目中眵), benefits the large intestine, frees the blood vessels, and benefits the complexion.
